project_type: React Native (Expo) mobile apps + Express.js API gateway + PostgreSQL/CockroachDB
build_system: npm; api-gateway uses tsc for build; apps use Expo (no native build needed for logic changes)
test_framework: Jest (api-gateway: `npm test`); no test framework in apps
verification_instructions: 1. Run `cd services/api-gateway && npm run build` — must emit zero TypeScript errors. 2. Run `npm test` in api-gateway — existing tests must pass. 3. Apply migration manually: `node scripts/migrate.js $DATABASE_URL`. 4. For apps, `cd apps/passenger-app && npx tsc --noEmit` and `cd apps/driver-app && npx tsc --noEmit`.
snapshot_or_generated_files: services/api-gateway/dist/ — produced by `npm run build`. Not checked in.
environment_constraints: API gateway deploys to Vercel serverless — no persistent WebSocket server. Real-time is implemented via polling (`setInterval` + REST) not native WebSockets. Do NOT add socket.io or ws server. The api-gateway has no socket.ts file. Driver location uses in-memory Map reset on cold-start; same pattern must be used for trip state notifications.
contribution_requirements: Keep migrations additive (ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS). Migration files are numbered sequentially; next is 012. Each migration is applied once via scripts/migrate.js. Source stays in src/, compiled to dist/.
key_patterns: 1. Routes use `pool.query` directly — no ORM. 2. Auth token decoded in middleware/auth.ts; `req.user.id` holds the caller's UUID and `req.user.type` holds 'passenger'|'driver'|'operator'|'admin'. 3. requireRole() imported from middleware/auth.ts (not rbac.ts) — use the one in auth.ts for per-route guards since it reads `req.user.type`. 4. Trips table: base columns in 001_base_schema.sql; payment columns added in 011_payments.sql; status currently uses 'pending'/'driver_assigned'/'driver_arriving'/'in_progress'/'completed'/'cancelled' strings (not a DB enum). 5. Passenger app: Expo, screens in apps/passenger-app/screens/, navigation in App.tsx (NativeStackNavigator). 6. Driver app (separate RN app): src/screens/main/ and src/screens/trip/; DriverAPI in src/services/api/DriverAPI.ts; APIClient in src/services/api/client.ts base URL = 'https://simon-daladala-api.vercel.app/api'. 7. Passenger app also has its own driver screens: DriverTripRequestScreen.tsx, DriverActiveTripScreen.tsx — these are the screens that WILL be changed. 8. State machine transitions broadcast to clients via polling endpoint (same pattern as tracking.ts). 9. Atomic accept: use FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED on the DB row to prevent two drivers accepting same trip.
directory_structure: daladala/services/api-gateway/src/routes/ — one file per route group; daladala/services/api-gateway/migrations/ — numbered SQL files; daladala/apps/passenger-app/screens/ — all passenger AND passenger-side driver screens; daladala/apps/driver-app/src/ — separate full RN app with contexts, navigation, screens/main, screens/trip
